##### Project general facts

Peninsula Three is a residential tower by Select Group, designed by the architectural studio Killa Design. The slender high-rise rises above a landscaped podium, and its glazed facades are oriented to open up wide views from every apartment. The tower brings together studios, one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments, crowned by a viewing deck on its upper level.

Residents enjoy a wet deck with a lap pool, a leisure pool and a dedicated kids' pool, together with a fully equipped gym, a yoga deck and an outdoor lounge. A coworking space supports those who work from home, while a welcoming residents' lounge, concierge service, round-the-clock security and covered parking add everyday convenience. Across the wider community there are tennis and padel courts, a running track, a basketball court, a skate park, a children's play area, manicured gardens and a promenade lined with shops, dining venues and boutique cafés.

Interiors pair timber-look flooring and terrazzo-effect porcelain with deep blue accents, textured stone in the bathrooms and floor-to-ceiling glazing that frames the city views. Open-plan living and dining areas flow towards private balconies, and kitchens come fitted with built-in appliances and stone countertops.

##### Location description and benefits

Business Bay is one of Dubai's central business and residential districts, set along both banks of the Dubai Canal immediately south of Downtown Dubai. Burj Khalifa, The Dubai Mall and Dubai Opera lie a short drive away, while Sheikh Zayed Road, Al Khail Road and Al Saada Street connect the area with the rest of the city.

Business Bay Metro Station on the Red Line serves the district, and water taxis and abras run along the canal. Supermarkets, cafés and restaurants line the canal promenade and Bay Avenue, schools and clinics in neighbouring Al Safa, Al Quoz and Downtown Dubai are easily reached, and the canal boardwalk offers jogging and cycling routes with views across the water.

The district attracts steady rental demand from professionals working in Downtown Dubai and DIFC, as well as from short-stay visitors drawn by its central position. Property in Business Bay is freehold and open to foreign buyers, and the area is positioned as a prime urban address that combines business, lifestyle and waterfront living.
